description: Swipe-compare two layers with a draggable divider.

descriptionFull.title: A comparison tool that reveals one layer against another behind a draggable divider on the map. Entered contextually from a layer's three-dots (kebab) menu via 'Compare layer', then pick a second layer to compare. Completely independent: it drives the core swipe capability and reads layers purely through the mmgisAPI event bus.

name: Comparison
